subject: Kickoff: black-box debiasing service (ml_debiaser)
body:
Hi Santiago,

Kicking off the debiasing-service project (Feb 16 – May 11). The research assets are our two NeurIPS releases: a near-optimal post-processing method (randomized_threshold) that debiases binary classifiers treated purely as black boxes, and a reduce-to-binary pre-processing method for multiclass datasets. The multiclass one is the product hook — it needs no sensitive attribute at inference time, which is exactly the constraint our internal model teams keep hitting.

Milestones:
- Mid-March: both methods wrapped behind one internal API, walk-through example ported.
- Mid-April: pilot with two model teams, bias metrics before/after in Evalline.
- Early May: rollout recommendation plus a Corpus integration plan for debiased dataset generation.

Can you send staffing, compute, and the Corpus dependency read by early March?

Thanks,
Dmitri
